QuestInfo.name: [Sengoku Warriors] Grendel's Library
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Athena Pierce in the Bowman Instructional School.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce recommends thay you visit Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia's Magic Library. Talk to Grendel the Really Old.
QuestInfo.2: Not even Grendel the Really Old could tell you more about the dimensional shift of Honnou-ji or the Demon King.
